info.title: Copilot Managed Runtime
info.description: Dual-mode connector for Microsoft Copilot Managed Runtime (public preview). Manages Copilot Managed Runtime app lifecycle - create, list, build, deploy, share, and assign roles - plus connector and connection discovery. Exposes an MCP endpoint for Copilot Studio agents alongside typed operations with full schemas for Power Automate. Wraps the Power Platform API 'appframework' service used by the @microsoft/managed-apps-cli 'ms' CLI.

post.description: Model Context Protocol endpoint for Copilot Studio integration. Provides Copilot Managed Runtime app lifecycle, sharing, and connectivity tools.

get.description: List all Copilot Managed Runtime apps in a Power Platform environment. Returns app ID, display name, description, environment, and backing repository.

parameters.name: permission
parameters.description: Filter apps by the permission the caller holds. 'read' returns apps you can play, 'write' returns apps you can edit.

parameters.name: skipToken
parameters.description: Continuation token from a previous response to fetch the next page

appCount.description: Number of apps returned in this page

nextLink.description: URL for the next page of results, when more results exist

skipToken.description: Continuation token extracted from the next link, for use in a follow-up request

post.description: Upload a built app artifact as a zip. The service commits it to the app's backing repository and returns the commit SHA, which Deploy Managed Runtime app can then deploy. Power Platform limits the overall payload to 100 MB, so use the 'ms deploy --artifact' CLI command for larger artifacts.

parameters.name: appId
parameters.description: The Copilot Managed Runtime app ID

schema.description: The built app output packaged as a zip file

commitSha.description: The commit created from the uploaded artifact

artifactBytes.description: Size of the uploaded artifact in bytes

message.description: What to do next with the returned commit SHA

post.description: Start GitHub authorization for a bring-your-own repository. Returns a one-time user code and a verification URI the user must visit to authorize the Managed Apps GitHub App, plus a session ID for polling.

repositoryUrl.description: The repository URL, for example https://github.com/owner/repo

sessionId.description: Session ID to pass to Get GitHub Auth Status

userCode.description: One-time code the user enters at the verification URI

verificationUri.description: URL the user opens to enter the code

pollIntervalSeconds.description: Seconds to wait between status checks

oauthBaseUri.description: GitHub base URI for this repository, to pass to Get GitHub Auth Status

owner.description: Repository owner parsed from the URL

repo.description: Repository name parsed from the URL

post.description: Check whether the user has finished GitHub authorization. Poll while the state is Pending, waiting the poll interval returned when the session started.

sessionId.description: The session ID returned by Start GitHub Auth

oauthBaseUri.description: The OAuth base URI returned by Start GitHub Auth. Defaults to https://github.com when omitted.

state.description: One of Pending, Complete, Denied, NotFound, or Expired

isPending.description: True while waiting for the user to finish signing in

githubLogin.description: The authorized GitHub account, set once complete

mappingExpiresAt.description: When the account mapping expires, set once complete

message.description: Human readable explanation of the current state
